description: The mouse map of QNC (user rule 2026-10-20, locked): what the mouse does on a timeline is one catalog action of contracts/qnc-keyboard-shortcuts.json, the same rule as the keys. A left click places the playhead (on a cover's colour strip it selects the slot); while something is taken a left click keeps it first (as Enter) and then places the playhead. A right click is Ctrl+: it takes what it points at (the nearest IN or OUT, the nearest M marker, the slot on a colour strip, A1/A2); the locked start and end markers are not taken. A drag moves only what is taken. Shift + left click adds (an M marker there, as Shift+M). The middle button is the cut. The wheel is the left/right arrows, Ctrl+wheel (or the wheel with the right button held) Ctrl+left/right. Pointer names are the timeline's (qnc-mouse-map); an action left out means the pointer does nothing on that panel.
